Sliders

A versatile slider component with prev/next controls, pagination, auto-play, drag/swipe, responsive breakpoints, and GSAP-enhanced transitions.

Basic Slider

Add `data-zaiku-slider` to a container with `.zaiku-slider-slide` children. Enable controls and pagination via `data-show-controls` and `data-show-pagination`.

Auto-play

Use `data-autoplay` to auto-advance. Set `data-interval` on each `.zaiku-slider-slide` for per-slide timing (falls back to the global `data-interval`). A timer bar shows at the top.

You gotta be fast!

A 2 second slide for fast readers

1.5 seconds ~ No time for banners!

Kinda normal

3 seconds should be enough...

Boring 5s slider?

No problem, take your time!

Multi-view

Show multiple slides at once with `data-slides-per-view`. Add `data-gap` to space them.

Card A

Two cards visible at once with 16px gap.

Card B

Each card is half the container width.

Card C

Three slides total, controls let you browse.

Card D

Pagination dots update on each slide change.

Vertical Slider

Add `data-direction=

` for vertical sliding. Controls, pagination, and drag/swipe adapt automatically. Add `data-pagination-left` to place pagination on the left.
Up

Swipe up or press ∨

Down

Swipe down or press ∧

Vertical

Works with auto-play, loop, and counter too.

Pagination

Dots stack vertically on the right side.

Drag & Swipe

Enable `data-draggable` for mouse drag and touch swipe. Drag past 30% of a slide width to advance.

← Drag me →

Click and drag to navigate slides.

Touch ready

Works with mouse and touch events.

Snappy

Snaps to nearest slide on release.

Image slider

Use `.zaiku-slider-slide` with background images or `` tags for image galleries.

Programmatic API

Access the slider instance via `container.zaiku.sliderInstance` or create one with `new Zaiku.Slider()`. Use `goTo()`, `next()`, `prev()`, `start()`, `stop()`, and `destroy()`. Check the console for `onSlide` events.

API Demo

Use the buttons below to control this slider.
